dedupe_keys.name: red vial nacional invias national road network colombia

description: Red Vial is the national road network dataset of Colombia's National Roads Institute (INVÍAS), published on the national open data portal. The national road network is made up of the trunk roads, transversal roads and access roads to departmental capitals that connect the country's main production and consumption areas with each other and with neighbouring countries. The dataset has 715 section records with the route and section codes and names, carriageway, category, surface, start and end reference posts and distances, administering body and road administration group, territorial office, sector and source, together with the line geometry. Coverage is national for the roads in the INVÍAS network. The data are free under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence and available through the Socrata portal as a table and API with export to CSV and geospatial formats; rows were last updated in September 2026. Caveats: it covers the national network only, not departmental or municipal roads, and conditions and traffic are not included. The network with surface and administration attributes supports network flow, criticality and hazard exposure analysis of Colombian highways, for example for landslide or flood closures. It complements the Aerocivil air transport statistics and is related to OpenStreetMap.
